whyZenit.title: Why Zenit?
whyZenit.subtitle: A school with clear expectations, structured teaching and opportunities to apply knowledge in practice.

paragraphs: At Zenit School, student progress is built through clear teaching, sustained effort and cooperation between the school and families.

Our programmes combine academic content with technology, coding, practical projects and physical activity. This approach helps students develop lasting knowledge, critical thinking, responsibility and independence.

reasons.title: Clear and structured teaching
reasons.text: Every topic is taught through understandable objectives, careful explanation and continuous monitoring of progress.

reasons.title: Knowledge applied in practice
reasons.text: Students investigate, solve problems and complete projects that connect academic content with practical application.
points: Web development in upper secondary school

reasons.title: Well-rounded development and support
reasons.text: Academic development is supported by physical activity, personal responsibility and regular communication with families.
points: Swimming during school in the half-Olympic pool

steps.title: Clear objectives
steps.text: Students understand what they are expected to learn and which knowledge and skills they need to demonstrate.

steps.title: Guidance and practice
steps.text: Explanation, discussion and guided practice create the foundation for deep understanding and independent work.

steps.title: Application and progress
steps.text: Projects, practical tasks and teacher feedback help students use their knowledge and improve continuously.

highlights.label: A lasting academic foundation
highlights.note: Concepts are understood, practised and connected to prior knowledge.

highlights.label: Thinking and practical application
highlights.note: Students analyse, collaborate, use technology and solve problems.

highlights.label: Independence in learning
highlights.note: Students learn to organise their work, reflect and take responsibility for their progress.

cta.title: Experience Zenit School in person
cta.text: Visit the campus, explore the learning environment and receive information about our programmes, admissions, scholarships and financial assistance.
